meta.name: google-search-ads-builder
meta.description: End-to-end Google Search Ads campaign builder. Performs deep keyword research (competitor SEO, review language mining, Reddit/HN community terminology, site audit), builds keyword architecture with funnel mapping and intent classification, creates ad group structure, generates headline/description variants, builds negative keyword lists, recommends bid strategy, and exports a campaign-ready CSV for Google Ads Editor import.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成可导入 Google Ads 的搜索广告系列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建结构化的 Google 搜索广告系列。
copy.tagline_en: Build Google Search Ads campaigns ready for import
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create structured Google Search ad campaigns.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你提供产品信息，然后自动完成关键词研究、广告组结构设计、广告文案生成，并输出一个可直接导入 Google Ads Editor 的 CSV 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建 Google 搜索广告、进行关键词研究或生成广告文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭建一个 Google 搜索广告系列，推广我们的 SaaS 产品。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集产品信息并执行完整流程。

say.text: 为我们的 CRM 工具做关键词研究，找出高意向词。
say.note: Claude 会进行深度关键词挖掘并输出列表。

say.text: 生成 3 条响应式搜索广告文案，针对“销售自动化”这个主题。
say.note: Claude 会生成标题和描述变体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to provide product info, then automatically perform keyword research, build ad group structure, generate ad copy, and export a CSV ready for Google Ads Editor import.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up Google Search Ads, do keyword research, or generate ad copy.

say_en.text: Set up a Google Search Ads campaign for our SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will start collecting product info and run the full process.

say_en.text: Do keyword research for our CRM tool, find high-intent terms.
say_en.note: Claude will perform deep keyword mining and output a list.

say_en.text: Generate 3 responsive search ads for the topic 'sales automation'.
say_en.note: Claude will create headline and description variants.
